note: Imported in Overhaul slice 1 (data only). No game system reads this file yet.

entries.name: Sudden Downpour
entries.announce: Dark clouds roll in overhead.
entries.effect: Rain starts at end of next turn.
entries.counterplay: Water and Electric users want it; Fire users can switch out early.

entries.name: Falling Debris
entries.announce: Pebbles trickle down from above.
entries.effect: At end of turn 3, each active Pokémon takes 1/16 max HP (Rock-types immune).
entries.counterplay: Rock-types and fast KOs avoid it.

entries.name: Gale
entries.announce: The wind starts to build.
entries.effect: Flying-types gain +1 Speed.
entries.counterplay: Non-Flying teams can slow the pace with a stalling move.

entries.name: Unstable Ground
entries.announce: The ground trembles slightly.
entries.effect: Ground moves gain +20% power.
entries.counterplay: Flying and Levitate users are untouched by Ground moves.

entries.name: Strange Energy
entries.announce: The air hums with something unseen.
entries.effect: Psychic and Fairy moves gain +10% crit chance.
entries.counterplay: Dark-types are unaffected by the Psychic half of the hum.

entries.name: Fog
entries.announce: Mist begins to gather.
entries.effect: Accuracy of all moves −5% until it clears.
entries.counterplay: Never-miss moves and No Guard are unaffected.

entries.name: Heat Wave
entries.announce: The air shimmers with heat.
entries.effect: Sun begins at end of next turn.
entries.counterplay: Water moves and switching soften the damage.

entries.name: Sandstorm Front
entries.announce: A tan haze stains the horizon.
entries.effect: Sandstorm begins at end of next turn.
entries.counterplay: Rock, Ground and Steel are immune to the chip.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.announce: A sudden chill creeps in.
entries.effect: Snow begins at end of next turn.
entries.counterplay: Ice-types gain; Fire moves are weaker in the cold.

entries.name: Thunderclap
entries.announce: Distant thunder rumbles closer.
entries.effect: Electric moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types shrug it off.

entries.name: Mud Slick
entries.announce: The ground turns soft and wet.
entries.effect: Ground-type Pokémon take −10% Speed.
entries.counterplay: Flyers are unaffected.

entries.name: Tremor
entries.announce: A low rumble passes under the field.
entries.effect: At end of turn 2, grounded Pokémon lose 1/32 max HP.
entries.counterplay: Fliers and Levitate are unaffected.

entries.name: Rockslide Warning
entries.announce: Loose stone clatters from the slope.
entries.effect: Rock moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Steel and Fighting resist the stones.

entries.name: Smoke Cloud
entries.announce: A thick plume rolls across the field.
entries.effect: Accuracy of Fire moves −10%.
entries.counterplay: Water moves clear the smoke.

entries.name: Mist Veil
entries.announce: A pale mist hugs the ground.
entries.effect: Stat drops from foes are prevented for 3 turns.
entries.counterplay: Direct damage is unchanged.

entries.name: Aurora Sky
entries.announce: Green light starts to ripple above.
entries.effect: Ice and Fairy moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Fire and Steel resist the shimmer.

entries.name: Sunbeam
entries.announce: A break opens in the clouds.
entries.effect: Healing moves restore +10% more.
entries.counterplay: Prevents nothing; a pure comfort.

entries.name: Shadow Fall
entries.announce: The light begins to fail.
entries.effect: Dark and Ghost moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Fairy and Normal resist the dark.

entries.name: Whirlwind Gust
entries.announce: Leaves spin up in a tight ring.
entries.effect: Pokémon switching in take −1/16 max HP.
entries.counterplay: Heavy hitters should avoid a risky swap.

entries.name: Static Field
entries.announce: A crackle runs through the air.
entries.effect: Electric moves gain +10% power; Ground moves lose 10%.
entries.counterplay: Rubber-boot swaps and resistances help.

entries.name: Tidal Surge
entries.announce: The sea pulls back with a hiss.
entries.effect: Water moves gain +20% power for 2 turns.
entries.counterplay: Grass and Dragon resist the surge.

entries.name: Wildfire
entries.announce: Smoke rises from the tree line.
entries.effect: Fire moves gain +10% power; Grass-types lose 1/16 max HP at end of turn 3.
entries.counterplay: Water and Fire types hold up best.

entries.name: Lightning Storm
entries.announce: Heavy clouds crack with light.
entries.effect: Rain begins at end of next turn; Electric moves gain +10% crit chance.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types are the safe choice.

entries.name: Hailstorm Front
entries.announce: Pale clouds drop in low.
entries.effect: Hail begins at end of next turn.
entries.counterplay: Ice-types are immune; others take chip.

entries.name: Ash Fall
entries.announce: Grey flakes begin to drift down.
entries.effect: Accuracy of all moves −5% until it clears.
entries.counterplay: Never-miss moves and No Guard are unaffected.

entries.name: Quake
entries.announce: The ground shudders once, deeply.
entries.effect: At end of turn 2, all active Pokémon take 1/16 max HP (Flying, Levitate immune).
entries.counterplay: Flyers and Levitate users take nothing.

entries.name: Stone Rain
entries.announce: Small stones begin to patter down.
entries.effect: Rock-types take −10% Special damage for 3 turns; all others take 1/32 max HP at end of turn.
entries.counterplay: Rock-types actually enjoy it.

entries.name: Overgrowth
entries.announce: Vines slip over the ground.
entries.effect: Grass moves gain +10% power; Speed −5% for all.
entries.counterplay: Fire moves cut through the vines.

entries.name: Glass Rain
entries.announce: Something glitters high up.
entries.effect: Fairy and Ice moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Steel and Fire resist the shards.

entries.name: Dust Devil
entries.announce: A spinning dust column rises.
entries.effect: Accuracy of Physical moves −5%.
entries.counterplay: Special attackers are unaffected.

entries.name: Moonrise
entries.announce: The moon edges above the horizon.
entries.effect: Ghost and Psychic moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Dark-types resist Psychic.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.announce: The sun starts to go dark.
entries.effect: Dark moves gain +10% power; Fairy moves lose 10%.
entries.counterplay: Steel and Fighting are not bothered.

entries.name: Shockwave
entries.announce: Metal hums with a rising pitch.
entries.effect: Steel and Electric moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types brush off the Electric half.

entries.name: Sinkhole
entries.announce: A circle of ground sags.
entries.effect: Ground moves gain +20% power; Flying immune.
entries.counterplay: Flyers and Levitate users avoid it.

entries.name: Rolling Fog
entries.announce: Fog banks roll in off the water.
entries.effect: Accuracy of all moves −5%; Water moves gain +5% power.
entries.counterplay: Never-miss moves are unaffected.

entries.name: Arc Flash
entries.announce: Sparks drift off the machinery.
entries.effect: Steel moves gain +10% power; Electric moves gain +10% crit chance.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types shrug it off.

entries.name: Spore Drift
entries.announce: Pale spores float on the wind.
entries.effect: Spore-based moves gain +10% accuracy.
entries.counterplay: Grass-types are immune to spores.

entries.name: Searing Noon
entries.announce: The sky bleaches white.
entries.effect: Sun begins; Fire moves gain +10%; Water moves −10%.
entries.counterplay: Water-types can still hit hard.

entries.name: Bitter Wind
entries.announce: The wind starts to bite.
entries.effect: Fire moves lose 10% power.
entries.counterplay: Ice and Steel don't mind.

entries.name: Terror Tide
entries.announce: A low horn sounds across the water.
entries.effect: Water moves gain +10% power; speed −5% for all.
entries.counterplay: Use Grass and Electric to flip the tide.

entries.name: Titan's Step
entries.announce: The ground rings with distant footfalls.
entries.effect: At end of turns 2 and 4, all grounded Pokémon take 1/32 max HP.
entries.counterplay: Flyers are unaffected.

entries.name: Stormwall
entries.announce: A dark line of clouds closes in.
entries.effect: Rain begins; Electric moves gain +10% crit chance.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types are protected.

entries.name: Firewall
entries.announce: A line of fire races across the field.
entries.effect: Fire moves gain +10% power; Fire-types heal 1/16 at end of turn.
entries.counterplay: Water moves and weather change it.

entries.name: Wintergale
entries.announce: A white wall of wind arrives.
entries.effect: Ice moves gain +10%; Fire and Grass lose −5% Speed.
entries.counterplay: Fire-types should switch to avoid it.

entries.name: Blackout
entries.announce: The lights go out all at once.
entries.effect: Accuracy of all moves −10% for 2 turns.
entries.counterplay: Never-miss moves are unaffected.

entries.name: Legend's Hush
entries.announce: The wind stops. Nothing moves.
entries.effect: Priority moves are blocked for 2 turns.
entries.counterplay: Switching is the only option.

entries.name: Rift Tremor
entries.announce: Space ripples at the edge of vision.
entries.effect: Psychic and Dragon moves gain +10% power.
entries.counterplay: Dark and Fairy resist the rift.

entries.name: World-Tree Bloom
entries.announce: Pale blossoms fall from nowhere.
entries.effect: Grass and Fairy moves gain +10%; all recover 1/32 HP at end of turn.
entries.counterplay: Fire and Poison cut through.

entries.name: Abyss Pressure
entries.announce: The air feels heavy, like deep water.
entries.effect: Speed of all Pokémon −5%.
entries.counterplay: Water-types stay mobile.

entries.name: Reactor Leak
entries.announce: An alarm starts to sound.
entries.effect: At end of turn 2, all active non-Steel Pokémon take 1/16 max HP.
entries.counterplay: Steel-types are immune.

entries.name: Signal Jammer
entries.announce: A machine hums at a high pitch.
entries.effect: Move accuracy −5% for all; boosting is blocked for 2 turns.
entries.counterplay: Never-miss moves are unaffected.

entries.name: Gravity Device
entries.announce: The machine spools up.
entries.effect: Gravity applies for 3 turns: Flying and Levitate lose immunity to Ground.
entries.counterplay: Levitate users are caught off guard.

entries.name: Cryo Vent
entries.announce: A pipe hisses frost across the floor.
entries.effect: Snow begins; Ice moves gain +10%.
entries.counterplay: Fire resists the vent.

entries.name: Overload Coil
entries.announce: A coil crackles and glows brighter.
entries.effect: Electric moves gain +20% power; Ground moves lose 10%.
entries.counterplay: Ground-types shrug it off.

entries.name: Toxin Spill
entries.announce: A vat tips and a sour smell spreads.
entries.effect: At end of turn 2, non-Poison and non-Steel Pokémon take 1/16 max HP.
entries.counterplay: Poison and Steel avoid it.
